notificationsSettings.connectSlackHint: Connect Slack in your organization settings to receive notifications in a Slack channel.
notificationsSettings.severityThresholdDescription: Only receive notifications for vulnerabilities that meet the selected severity levels.
notificationsSettings.scannerTypesDescription: Only receive notifications for results from selected scanner types.
notificationsSettings.scanCompleteDescription: Get notified when a scan finishes with a summary of the results.
notificationsSettings.emailAlertDescription: Receive email alerts in the event of new critical vulnerabilities in your project.
notificationsSettings.monthlyReportDescription: Receive a complete vulnerability report of your project each month by email.
notificationsSettings.weeklyReportDescription: Receive a complete vulnerability report of your project each week by email.
notificationsSettings.incidentCreationDescription: You can select a parameter for incident creation. This setting is directly assigned to "ticketing & notifications" integrations. You can choose whether you want to create an incident for a vulnerability group or for each occurrence.
